name: v0.2.3 — Ephemeral Commands, Reply/Summarize Tracking, Bug Fixes
body:
## v0.2.3 — Ephemeral Commands (Aug 28, 2026)

### ✨ New Features

**Ephemeral Commands** — /summarize, /reply, /transcribe, /start, and /help are now declared as ephemeral via `is_ephemeral: True`. When you type these commands in a group, no one else sees the command message — it is invisible to other members.

**Reply Tracking System** — Removed the old "Reply to this" inline button. Now /reply scans all unreplied voice transcriptions (from other users only), generates a single LLM response, marks them as replied, and sends the result as an ephemeral message.

**Summarize Tracking System** — /summarize scans all unsummarized voice transcriptions (from other users only), summarizes them, marks as summarized, and sends the result as an ephemeral message.

**Backlog Transcribe Command** — Added /transcribe command for backlog force-transcription.

### 🔧 Bug Fixes
- Config crash on old format: strips removed auth_required_callback field
- Empty LLM response: messages not marked as actioned if LLM returns empty
- Robust response parsing: handles both message.content and .text formats
- Exclude own messages from /summarize and /reply

### 🧹 Cleanup
- Removed auth_required_callback, CallbackQueryHandler, inline buttons

### 📊 Dashboard Changes
- Added Reply age limit and Summarize age limit settings
- Removed button auth toggle

### ⚙️ Under the Hood
- replied/summarized columns in SQLite
- get_unreplied/get_unsummarized/mark_as_replied/mark_as_summarized queries
- reply_retention_days and summarize_retention_days config (default 30)
- Auto-migration of old config files on load
